title: A variable cannot use a variable defined after it
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR a = b + 1 VAR b = 2 RETURN a )

expected.error: b is not defined yet when a is defined

source.quote: the definition of a variable can reference other variables provided that the other variables have been defined beforehand
source.supports: only variables defined beforehand can be referenced

source.quote: A variable nameN is visible in all the expressionN+1 of following variables defined within the same VAR/RETURN statement.
source.supports: a variable is visible to the definitions that follow it, not to the ones before

derivation: a is defined before b, so b is not visible in the definition of a and the query fails.
